name: How do LED strip lights compare to puck lights for under-cabinet illumination?

mainEntity.name: How do LED strip lights compare to puck lights for under-cabinet illumination?

acceptedAnswer.text: LED strip tape and puck lights are the two primary options, differing mainly in light distribution and installation footprint. Continuous LED strip lighting produces an even, seamless wash of light across the entire countertop, making it ideal for continuous prep zones and reflective surfaces. Puck lights deliver focused, circular pools of light, creating dramatic accent points but potentially causing hot spots on glossy countertops. A key decision factor is your cabinet profile: recessed LED tape channels hide flush under shallow cabinet lips, while puck lights require deeper under-cabinet recesses or custom valances to avoid direct glare.
acceptedAnswer.description: LED strip lights provide continuous, even light across countertops, while puck lights create focused circular beams that work best for dramatic accent lighting.
